display.title: Engineering I - The Create Foundry
display.subtitle: Submit Create-tier materials & machines
description: The Tier 1 engineering economy runs on Create. Submit refined metals and
finished kinetic machines to the Codex; each conversion adds to your pool.
Sample submissions from the T1 conversion table (full table in the Codex):
- Iron / Copper / Gold / Redstone - bulk metals, 1 token per 100 (capped)
- Brass, Andesite Alloy, Steel - 1 token per 50 (capped)
- Mechanical machines (Press, Mixer, Saw, Drill...) - high value each
Submit the materials below to bank your first Engineering tokens.
Repeat across the table to close on Tier 2 by building alone (~118% of 500).
